# AgentLab

> AgentLab is the self-hosted sandbox orchestration platform for AI agents.
> Sandboxes are ephemeral VMs and containers with built-in agent support,
> credential proxying, and zero-config networking.

## Quick Start

```
# Create a sandbox
agentlab new --profile my-profile

# Create with a prompt (agent-ready image)
agentlab new --profile agent-claude --prompt "build a web server"

# List sandboxes
agentlab ls

# SSH into a sandbox
agentlab ssh <vmid>

# Destroy a sandbox
agentlab rm <vmid>
```

## Command Reference

### Short Aliases (80/20)

| Alias | Full Command | Description |
|-------|-------------|-------------|
| `new` | `sandbox new` | Create a sandbox |
| `ls` | `sandbox list` | List sandboxes |
| `show` | `sandbox show` | Show sandbox details |
| `ssh` | `ssh` | SSH into a sandbox |
| `start` | `sandbox start` | Start a sandbox |
| `stop` | `sandbox stop` | Stop a sandbox |
| `rm` | `sandbox destroy` | Destroy a sandbox |
| `logs` | `logs` | View sandbox logs |

### Full Command Tree

```
agentlab status                          # Daemon status
agentlab schema                          # API schema
agentlab init                            # Initialize agentlab on host
agentlab bootstrap                       # Bootstrap a remote host

agentlab job run                         # Run a job (repo + task + profile)
agentlab job show <id>                   # Show job details
agentlab job artifacts <id>              # List job artifacts
agentlab job artifacts download <id>     # Download job artifacts

agentlab sandbox new                     # Create sandbox
agentlab sandbox list                    # List sandboxes
agentlab sandbox show <vmid>             # Show sandbox details
agentlab sandbox start <vmid>            # Start sandbox
agentlab sandbox stop <vmid>             # Stop sandbox
agentlab sandbox destroy <vmid>          # Destroy sandbox
agentlab sandbox snapshot save <vmid>    # Save snapshot
agentlab sandbox snapshot list <vmid>    # List snapshots
agentlab sandbox snapshot restore <vmid> # Restore snapshot
agentlab sandbox expose <vmid> :<port>   # Expose port
agentlab sandbox lease renew <vmid>      # Renew lease

agentlab workspace create                # Create persistent workspace
agentlab workspace list                  # List workspaces
agentlab workspace attach <ws> <vmid>    # Attach workspace to sandbox
agentlab workspace detach <ws>           # Detach workspace

agentlab session create                  # Create session (sandbox + workspace)
agentlab session list                    # List sessions
agentlab session fork <session>          # Fork a session

agentlab token create --key <path>       # Create scoped API token
agentlab token list                      # List token signing keys
agentlab token inspect <token>           # Inspect token claims

agentlab integration add                 # Add integration (http-proxy, git-proxy)
agentlab integration list                # List integrations
agentlab integration rm <name>           # Remove integration

agentlab user add --key <ssh-key>        # Add user via SSH key
agentlab user list                       # List users
agentlab team add                        # Add team
agentlab team members                    # List team members

agentlab defaults write <key> <value>    # Set CLI preference
agentlab defaults read <key>             # Read CLI preference
agentlab defaults list                   # List all preferences
agentlab version                         # Show version info
agentlab completion <bash|zsh|fish>      # Generate shell completions
```

## Global Flags

All commands support:

- `--json` — Output JSON for programmatic use
- `--endpoint URL` — Control plane endpoint (for remote access)
- `--token TOKEN` — Auth token
- `--socket PATH` — Daemon socket path
- `--timeout DURATION` — Request timeout

## Defaults System

Persistent CLI preferences stored in `~/.config/agentlab/defaults.json`:

```bash
agentlab defaults write default-profile my-profile
agentlab defaults write output-format json
agentlab defaults write default-backend docker
```

Well-known keys: `default-profile`, `default-image`, `default-backend`,
`output-format`, `default-timeout`, `default-socket`.

## Sandboxes

Sandbox types:
- **VM** — Full virtual machine via Proxmox (default)
- **LXC** — Lightweight container via Proxmox LXC
- **Docker** — Local Docker container

```bash
# Create with specific type
agentlab new --type lxc --image ubuntu:22.04

# Create with prompt for agent
agentlab new --profile agent-claude --prompt "implement auth module"

# Manage lifecycle
agentlab start <vmid>
agentlab stop <vmid>
agentlab rm <vmid>
```

## Built-in Guest Services

Every sandbox has access to `http://169.254.169.254/` providing:

- `GET /identity` — Sandbox name, ID, profile, tags, owner
- `GET /metadata` — Key-value metadata set at creation
- `/proxy/llm/v1/chat/completions` — LLM proxy (no API key inside sandbox)
- `/proxy/git/*` — Git proxy with credential injection
- `/proxy/{name}/*` — Generic HTTP API proxy
- `GET /secrets/{name}` — On-demand secret access
- `POST /email` — Email/notification gateway

## Integrations

Network-level secret injection — secrets never exist inside the sandbox:

```bash
# Add an HTTP API integration
agentlab integration add --type http-proxy --name myapi \
  --target https://api.example.com --bearer sk-...

# Add a Git integration
agentlab integration add --type git-proxy --name github \
  --token ghp_...

# Attach to sandboxes
agentlab integration add --type http-proxy --name myapi \
  --attach tag:production
```

## Authentication

- **SSH keys** — Primary auth mechanism for self-hosted
- **Scoped tokens** — Per-sandbox, per-command, time-limited API tokens
- **RBAC** — admin and user roles for multi-user deployments

```bash
# Create a scoped token
agentlab token create --key ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 \
  --cmds "sandbox" --scope "sandbox:1001" --ttl 8h

# Add a user
agentlab user add --key "ssh-ed25519 AAAA..." --name alice --role user
```

## Networking

- Automatic subdomain assignment: `<sandbox-name>.agentlab.local`
- Automatic TLS via self-signed CA (self-hosted) or Let's Encrypt (public)
- One-command expose: `agentlab sandbox expose mybox :8080 --public`
- Built-in reverse proxy (Caddy integration)

## Backends

Pluggable sandbox backends:

| Backend | Use Case |
|---------|----------|
| Proxmox | Production VM/LXC on bare metal |
| Docker | Local development, lightweight |
| libvirt | KVM/QEMU without Proxmox |

```bash
agentlab init --backend docker    # Use Docker locally
agentlab init --backend proxmox   # Use Proxmox (default)
```

## Configuration Files

- `/etc/agentlab/config.yaml` — Daemon configuration
- `~/.config/agentlab/client.json` — Client connection config
- `~/.config/agentlab/defaults.json` — CLI preference defaults
- `/run/agentlab/agentlabd.sock` — Unix domain socket

## Environment Variables

All config can be overridden with `AGENTLAB_` prefixed env vars:

- `AGENTLAB_ENDPOINT` — Control plane URL
- `AGENTLAB_TOKEN` — Auth token
- `AGENTLAB_TAILSCALE_TAILNET` — Tailscale tailnet name

## Shell Completion

```bash
# Bash
echo 'eval "$(agentlab completion bash)"' >> ~/.bashrc

# Zsh
echo 'eval "$(agentlab completion zsh)"' >> ~/.zshrc

# Fish
echo 'agentlab completion fish | source' >> ~/.config/fish/config.fish
```

## Agent-Ready Images

Pre-built images with coding agents installed:

- `agent-base` — Ubuntu with dev tools, git, build-essential
- `agent-claude` — agent-base + Claude Code CLI
- `agent-codex` — agent-base + OpenAI Codex CLI

```bash
agentlab new --image agent-claude --prompt "build a REST API"
```
